motion.scalar_motion_formula: ey at draw = -28 + 3 * age, absent removal; all pieces have identical y. Draw is before movement.
motion.link2_semantics: Type20 dat -2 at age5 sets the acceleration interval to2 and delta-v to-1; dat +2 at age15 changes delta-v to+1. These are not velocities. The first change slows/reverses only after accumulated velocity is repaid.
motion.link1_difference: The left family uses +2 then -2, opposite signs. Its event times and x placements are separate.

lifecycle.why_ground: explosiontype24 is even; this flag controls hit/ice/death appearance, while event7 still puts actors in the top-enemy draw pass.
lifecycle.first_level_live_overrides: No armor, animation, turret, drop, link reassignment, or special-flag overrides target this family during its3525–4100 eventtime interval; only listed type20 motion changes.
lifecycle.reward: Record79 only has source value1000; others0. Difficulty scaling applies. It is enemy cash on destruction, not a pickup actor.
lifecycle.nonlethal_damage: Only the struck actor armor is reduced. Ground hit filters are propagated to all active actors with link2.
lifecycle.lethal_damage: A lethal hit removes all active same-link2 actors through the shared death loop; link1 is not included. No wreck replacement because edlevel != -1.
lifecycle.ice: Damage99 becomes damage0 and sets iced40; this propagates to active ground actors with the same link. iced is decremented after drawing and after movement; it sets filter0x09 for a later draw and skips firing/launch. It does not stop this strip moving.
lifecycle.filter_transform: blit_sprite2_filter uses filter | (source_palette_index & 0x0f). Drawing clears filter0, then iced can set it again.
lifecycle.death_fx: JE_setupExplosionLarge(true,12,x,y): ground burst types2,4,3,5, then big=true repeating explosion ttl2. Repeats can generate generic air-large bursts; no new family sprite. Explosion allocation/RNG can limit actual effects.
lifecycle.exit: After drawing and acceleration, ex<−80 or ex>340 removes the individual actor; after eyc, ey<−112 or ey>190 removes it. tempBackMove3 is added after those checks. Rectangle reference clipping can stop well before removal.
